patch_description: The previous best-performing candidate (score 0.80) used a single shared parameter "theta" across both the pre- and post-entanglement rotation layers and relied entirely on fixed (parameter-free) entangling gates, achieving strong parameter economy (n_params=8). The current candidate regressed to 3 distinct parameter names (ry_global, xx_ent, rz_global), which increased n_params to 20 and dropped the score to 0.68 despite similar accuracy. This edit collapses all three parameter names back into a single shared "theta" parameter (reusing it for RY, the entangling XX gate, and RZ), maximizing parameter sharing while keeping the improved closed-ring topology (nearest-neighbor + wrap-around) from this generation. This should recover the parameter-economy benefits of the earlier best candidate while retaining the richer connectivity structure.
